description: The pie chart presents the distribution of narrative media framing categories in political discourse, showing four slices in total. The slices are labeled “Right bias” (blue) at approximately 30.0% with an internal label “30.0% (30),” “Left bias” (orange) at approximately 28.0% with “28.0% (28),” “Questionable source” (green) at approximately 22.0% with “22.0% (22),” and an unlabeled red slice at approximately 20.0% with “20.0% (20)” shown inside. Percentage-and-count labels appear inside each slice, there is no separate legend visible, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized; the slices appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller moving from the top/right area around the chart.
